summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload on npm install
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable (0o755), and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, ~1500-entry mixed numeric/string constant array, string-array cipher with a custom substitution alphabet, and a decoder function with randomized hex identifiers). The package's stated purpose is a lodash template compiler, and `index.js` is a ~90-line lodash template helper that never references `math_init.js` — the obfuscated payload is reachable only through the preinstall Bun-runner path. Pulling in a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time evades Node-based static review and grants the author arbitrary code execution on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
